content_metadata.description: An episode focusing on the Curiosity rover, its purpose, and the people behind its development.

youtube_description:
**ORDER our new book: http://WeHaveNoIdea.com

In this Ph.Detours episode, Alex and the gang visit the Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, California and go inside the Mars Rover Test lab and chat with engineers Chaz Morantz and (yes) Bobak Ferdowsi.

Visit our website: http://phdcomics.com/tv

Subscribe to our channel: http://youtube.com/subscription_center?add_user=phdcomics

More info about PHD Comics at: http://phdcomics.com
